name: Wang Mingxi
current_role: Chairman & General Manager, Jiangsu Gian Technology Co., Ltd. (精研科技, SZSE: 300709)
profile: Wang Mingxi (b. 1962, Chinese national) is co-controlling shareholder, chairman and general manager of Jiangsu Gian Technology, a Changzhou-based metal injection molding (MIM) parts maker and solutions provider founded in 2004 and listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext. He chaired its predecessor Changzhou Gian from Dec 2004 and chairs several subsidiaries.
interesting_fact: Gian (GIAN) is a specialist in metal powder injection molding (MIM) and has expanded into subsidiaries for power systems, thermal management and intelligent mobility (Jiangsu Gian Power Systems, Gian Thermal Management, Gian Zhixing Systems), all chaired by Wang.
deep_cut_fact: Before manufacturing, Wang spent 1985-1994 as a clerk at the Changzhou Personnel Bureau, then ran a local freight company (Changzhou Riyue Freight) from 1994 to 2000 and an internet tech firm (Changzhou Jiali Network Technology) from 2000.
notes: Lane input lists source as 'Gian' (consumer electronics); company is Jiangsu Gian Technology (not Shenzhen). Co-controller listed as Huang Yichao (company board secretary). Contact via IR/board office.
